title: The US-002 commit (f9809593) bundles an out-of-scope change: injecting a fake `…
body: The US-002 commit (f9809593) bundles an out-of-scope change: injecting a fake `patternsArchiveFn` into two dispatchJournal tests, unrelated to the resend_from feature (issue 218). The field is optional and pre-existing on main; the change hardens the tests against real-git side effects (a genuine improvement) but violates surgical-scope. Non-blocking.
